import json, sys, threading
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/wkoch/Projetos/xrai/crates/xrai-eval/harness')
from execution_gate import EvidenceSnapshot, OfflineAuthorization, preflight, make_smoke_fixture
from execution_dispatch_v2 import DispatchSessionV2, FakeTransportV2, DispatchBarriers, make_bindings, replay_dispatch_v2
from agent_ledger import fake_request, canonical, sha
manifest,evidence=make_smoke_fixture(); snapshot=EvidenceSnapshot.capture(manifest,evidence)
reached,release=threading.Event(),threading.Event()
transport=FakeTransportV2()
session=DispatchSessionV2(snapshot,preflight(snapshot),OfflineAuthorization(snapshot.fingerprint,1000,100),transport,bindings=make_bindings(snapshot,task_id='D0-RS-01',arm='direct',run_id='review-c05-request-ownership'),clock=lambda:1,barriers=DispatchBarriers(before_commit_reached=reached,before_commit_release=release))
request=fake_request(); original=sha(canonical(request)); observed=[]; errors=[]; results=[]
def profile(frame,event,arg):
    if event=='call' and frame.f_code.co_filename.endswith('/execution_dispatch_v2.py') and frame.f_code.co_name=='invoke':
        raw=canonical(frame.f_locals['request'])
        observed.append({'sha256':sha(raw),'request':json.loads(raw)})
def worker():
    sys.setprofile(profile)
    try:results.append(session.dispatch('a','c',request,500))
    except Exception as e:errors.append(repr(e))
    finally:sys.setprofile(None)
t=threading.Thread(target=worker);t.start()
assert reached.wait(5)
request['limits']['output_tokens']=99999
request['messages'][0]['content']='caller changed after reservation'
release.set();t.join(5);assert not t.is_alive()
record=session.record()
result={'scope':'fake_only_no_network_no_upstream_no_native','original_request_sha256':original,'recorded_request_sha256':record['attempts']['a']['request_sha256'],'transport_request':observed,'adapter_calls':transport.calls,'dispatch_results':results,'errors':errors,'replay':replay_dispatch_v2(record)}
assert not errors and transport.calls==1 and observed[0]['sha256']!=original
Path('/tmp/xrai-review-c05-dispatch-request.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'adapter_calls':transport.calls,'record_transport_hash_equal':original==observed[0]['sha256'],'transport_output_limit':observed[0]['request']['limits']['output_tokens'],'ledger_output_limit':100,'replay_status':result['replay']['status']}))
